description: Read robots.txt of https://<domain> and, if it allows us, /.well-known/security.txt, with up to 5 redirects on the host or its www pair. Gives the rules that bind us, sitemaps, fields such as Contact and Expires, and RFC 9309/9116 issues.

domain.description: Host name of the site, such as www.example.com

name: well_known

checked_at.description: When the check ran, in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. A cached answer keeps the time of its own check, up to an hour old.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

reason.description: Present only when the throttle refused the fetch. It is then quota_exhausted, and robots_txt and security_txt are null.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before the server sends that request again. Present only when reason is quota_exhausted.

robots_txt.description: null only when reason is quota_exhausted.

by_severity.description: It counts every issue the file raised, dropped ones too.

groups.description: The groups that bind ContrastAPI, its own and those of *, in file order. [] when no file was read. A file is read only when status_code is 2xx and issues lacks content_encoded. [] also when no group binds ContrastAPI or *.

crawl_delay.description: It is in seconds. null when the group has no valid Crawl-delay.

line.description: The line where the group starts.

issues.description: It lists at most 50 parser issues, then the server's own warnings. code is a fixed snake_case name of what the parser found, such as line_syntax_invalid. The server adds redirect_limit_reached when the fetch stopped at its redirect limit, and content_encoded when the body came encoded and was not read. severity is warning or info.

field.description: The directive or field the issue is about, or null.

line.description: It is the line, from 1, or null.

redirect_count.description: How many redirects came before the last request.

redirect_to.description: Present only when a redirect was left unfollowed. It holds its target, cut as url is.

sitemaps.description: It lists the Sitemap values, at most 100. [] when no file was read, as for groups.

status_code.description: It is the status of the last answer.

total_groups.description: Present only when groups dropped items. It counts them all.

total_issues.description: Present only when issues dropped items. It counts them all.

total_redirect_to_length.description: Present only when redirect_to was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

total_rules.description: Present only when a rule of those groups was dropped. It counts them all.

total_sitemaps.description: Present only when sitemaps dropped items. It counts them all.

total_url_length.description: Present only when url was cut. It gives the whole length in code points.

url.description: It is the URL of the last request, without its query. A value longer than 500 code points is cut there. Absent, with status_code and redirect_count, when no request was sent.

security_txt.description: null only when reason is quota_exhausted. The members from content_type to by_severity are present only when status is found. Each field list holds at most 20 values.

by_severity.description: It counts every issue the file raised, dropped ones too.

content_type.description: It is the Content-Type of the answer, or null without one.

deciding_rule.description: Present only when status is robots_disallowed. The robots.txt rule that decided, or null when no single rule did.

expires.description: The first Expires value as the file writes it, or null.

issues.description: It lists at most 50 parser issues, then content_encoded when the body came encoded. Their codes work as in robots_txt, such as contact_missing. severity is error, warning or info.

field.description: The directive or field the issue is about, or null.

line.description: It is the line, from 1, or null.

openpgp_signed.description: true when the file is a whole OpenPGP signed message. The signature is not verified.

status.description: found: a file came back with a 2xx status. not_found: the site answered an error status such as 404, so there is no file. too_large: the file passed the size limit. robots_disallowed: robots.txt forbids the fetch. robots_unknown: robots.txt could not be read, so no fetch was sent. not_fetched: no answer was read, such as when time ran out.

total_acknowledgments.description: Present only when acknowledgments dropped items. It counts them all.

total_canonical.description: Present only when canonical dropped items. It counts them all.

total_contact.description: Present only when contact dropped items. It counts them all.

total_csaf.description: Present only when csaf dropped items. It counts them all.

total_encryption.description: Present only when encryption dropped items. It counts them all.

total_hiring.description: Present only when hiring dropped items. It counts them all.

total_issues.description: Present only when issues dropped items. It counts them all.

total_policy.description: Present only when policy dropped items. It counts them all.

total_preferred_languages.description: Present only when preferred_languages dropped items. It counts them all.

unknown_field_count.description: It counts the lines whose field name is not known.

title: Robots.txt and security.txt Check
